name: Shantai Industries Limited
about: Shantai Industries Limited engages in the trading of textiles in India. It is involved in the export of synthetic textile items and finished garments in India. The company was formerly known as Wheel and Axle Textiles Limited and changed its name to Shantai Industries Limited in September 2016. Shantai Industries Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Surat, India.
